over_long_sentences.sentence: yml с PostgreSQL 18 (или 17 по шаблонам n8n-hosting ), healthcheck и локальным bind: services: postgres: image: postgres:18 restart: unless-stopped environment: POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER} POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD} POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB} volumes: - postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data healthcheck: test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d ${POSTGRES_DB}"] interval: 10s timeout: 5s retries: 5 n8n: image: docker
